title: Windline — ordered glider landing
summary: Can an executor produce a deterministic one-file glider microgame with ordered targets, readable lift zones, recoverable failure, and a precision landing loop?
benchmark_question: Can an executor implement and verify one deterministic flight-like control loop with ordered targets, failure recovery, and a constrained landing state in a single offline file?

evaluator.notes: Linux runner fails closed without bubblewrap user/network namespaces or Chromium's own sandbox, stages only index.html, blocks and records page egress before transmission, applies bounded source/request/error/deadline limits, and computes one final offline outcome after a late-event quiet window. It awards 70 objective points and captures controlled screenshots; ordered completion and presentation reserve 30 points for independent E2 review.

provenance.attribution: Original challenge authored for the OneShot compact core.
provenance.notes: Candidate challenge. Calibration completed on 2026-08-22, but activation was rejected: one run failed a critical controls criterion, the other violated the one-file output protocol, and both failed the full-course readability requirement. It remains closed until the readability contract is revised and a new version passes fresh calibration.

capabilities.environment: One frozen prompt producing a browser artifact that runs offline from file:// in current desktop Chromium, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
constraints: Exactly one self-contained index.html deliverable; no external assets, dependencies, network calls, or build step.
One fixed deterministic course with keyboard-complete play.
Contestant prompt excludes evaluator mechanics, weights, hidden variants, and retry policy.

budget.notes: T1 compact budget. Runtime is a harness control independent of tier; agentic and raw attempts must be recorded in separate result lanes.

verification.description: The artifact is one self-contained HTML file that boots from file:// without undeclared resource or network requests.
The read-only Windline snapshot has the documented shape, normalized state, and fresh-object isolation.
Enter starts a flying state and both vertical steering directions change documented motion state.
Out-of-order contact is rejected, chimes collect in order, hard contact crashes, and a gentle final rooftop landing reaches success.
Pause freezes motion, a controlled boundary or impact crash is reachable, and R restores a clean run.
Chime, thermal, and rooftop geometry stays unchanged across fresh restarts.
Required labelled controls exist, keyboard help is visible, and the page fits the 390 by 844 viewport without material overflow.
Glider, thermals, ordered chimes, rooftop target, current objective, and state feedback are readable in controlled desktop and mobile captures.

one_shot_policy.notes: One frozen brief per attempt. Agentic self-review may test and repair inside its fixed run; raw completion may not.
